title: pm-dispatch: seat-lifecycle.md counts release blockers over three repos and three boards, while seat-post-protocol.md defines the release list as two repos and two boards
body:
repo:objectstack#1 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgUkbQqRUUFSiu2HGob

Filing gate: ① fleet rule-text defect. Two passages of the skill contradict each other. Source: fleet. The isolated L2 review of PR #35671 (card #35237, record 7024997432) named it, and the diff does not touch either line. ⛔ Not a claim.

Grade: left to triage.

## What happens

- `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/seat-lifecycle.md` (the patrol metrics list, about line 78): 「发版阻塞 = 窗内三仓 open `priority:p0` 之和,归零 = 三张板都空」.
- `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/seat-post-protocol.md` (about lines 80–83): two producers, the main repo by the director seat and cloud by its whole-repo seat. 「维护者的发版清单 = 两仓两条查询 `label:priority:p0 is:open` … 归零 = 可发版指两张板都空」.

The second passage is the detailed definition. It names the producers, the consumer query and the zero condition, and it states two repos. The first names no third repo. A seat that reads the first counts a board nobody produces. PR #35671's `fleet-roster --health` now prints "three repos" and "in window" as unread legs rather than guess.

## Expected

The two passages agree. Unless the maintainer names a third board, the patrol metric reads the two producer repos the release list defines. If a third repo was meant (for example hotcrm), the release-list passage, its producers and its queries gain it instead. Either way, `fleet-roster --health` reads the same set.

## Done when

- `seat-lifecycle.md`'s release-blocker metric line and `seat-post-protocol.md`'s release-list lines name the same repos and boards.
- `fleet-roster --health` reads that set and no longer reports the repo count as an unread leg.

Who acts: area:fleet (pm-dispatch skill text, governed `.claude/**`).
